title: very fluffy british solo-dinner pudding
description: a spicy, fluffy, solo-dinner british dish featuring orange blossom water, lamination-puff, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients. serves one person.
instructions: combine water, cornstarch, and salt in a saucepan. cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture thickens.
remove the saucepan from the heat and add the grated ginger, orange blossom water, and cayenne pepper. whisk until well combined.
add the unsweetened almond milk and vanilla extract to the saucepan. whisk until the milk is fully incorporated and the mixture is smooth.
remove the puff pastry from the freezer and let it thaw at room temperature for 10 minutes.
roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
cut out a circle of puff pastry that is slightly larger than the saucepan. place the pastry circle on top of the saucepan and trim the edges to fit.
brush the pastry with a little water and sprinkle with coconut sugar.
bake the pudding in a preheated oven at 4008f for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
remove the pudding from the oven and sprinkle with turmeric powder and black pepper.
let the pudding cool for a few minutes before serving.
serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon powder, if desired.
keep the pudding at a safe internal temperature of 1458f or above during storage and service.
use a clean and sanitized utensil to handle the pudding when serving.
do not consume the pudding if it has been left at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
